name: Taylor Townsend
intro: Taylor Townsend is a lefty from Chicago with a huge smile. A lefty plays with the left hand. She loves to charge the net.
story: At 16, Taylor was the No. 1 junior in the world. She has won three Grand Slam doubles titles, the biggest tournaments in tennis. In 2025 she became the first mom ever ranked No. 1 in doubles. On Friday she rushed the net 44 times and beat the 15th seed. A seed is a top-ranked player, so that was huge!

funFacts.text: Her little son AJ gives her tennis tips: hit it where she isn't!
She grew up on the South Side of Chicago in a big tennis family.
She eats and writes with her left hand, and plays lefty too.
Her mom played college tennis. Her sister Symone did too.
Her tennis hero is lefty legend Martina Navratilova.
She has won Wimbledon, the Australian Open, and the French Open in doubles.

watchFor: Watch her serve and sprint to the net, a move almost nobody does anymore.
